(By Shri Satyapal Chaddar - Govt. Advocate For Respondent
 No.1/ State.
 None For Victim. )

This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e court  following:
 ORDER

This is the First appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A(1) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 assailing the order dated 30.11.2022 passed by the Special Judge (Atrocities), S.C./ S.T. Act, District Jabalpur in Case No. SC ATR/189/2019 arisen out of F.I.R. No. 419/2019 of P.S. Adhartal, District Jabalpur for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 365, 468, 376(2)(n), 370, 371, 506, 120-B, 34 of IPC and 3(2)(v) of the Prevention of S.C./ S.T. Atrocities whereby the application filed by the appellant under Sections 439 of Cr.P.C.
has been dismissed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant prays for withdrawal of the appeal.
The appeal stands dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed by the learned counsel for the appellant, learned trial Court is directed to dispose of the trial expeditiously preferably within six months from today.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Sunita Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37995110/
